verdict.rationale: Mistral's docs include a dedicated moderation page. It offers "Custom Guardrails (recommended)" that let developers declare moderation rules directly in API requests, with no separate calls or threshold logic needed, which is a first-party guardrail primitive. Custom Structured Outputs with JSON schemas add a way to constrain model output before downstream code acts on it. Missing for 10: detail on moderation categories, thresholds or a standalone moderation endpoint; documented patterns for gating tool or function-call execution before it acts; any independent or hands-on corroboration.
